about: a short grey-brown hickory haft, worn dark (art/parts/axe/handles.png)

length_m.source: near the short end of the axe's length envelope, 0.612 to 0.748 m (assets/data/kinds/axe.json)

grip_from_end_m.source: a hand's width up from the butt, the reference axe's (the D565 step 4 plan)

profile_m.source: a felling axe's handle: the swell-knob at the butt that keeps it from slipping out of the hand, and the slimmer throat under the head's shoulder (USDA Forest Service, An Ax to Grind, 1999, fig. 3, fs.usda.gov/eng/pubs/htmlpubs/htm99232823); the guide gives no sizes, so the knob a quarter wider than the grip and the throat a sixth slimmer, by eye against art/parts/axe/handles.png

density_kg_m3.source: hickory 600 to 930 kg/m^3, the middle (The Engineering ToolBox, Wood Species - Densities, engineeringtoolbox.com/wood-density-d_40.html, looked up 2026-10-28)
